summary: In the definition of `FV` for `.Letrec defs b`, Lean incorrectly scopes the set difference to only `FV b` instead of `(FV_defs defs ∪ FV b)`, causing recursive function names to incorrectly remain in the free variable set.

errors.lean_evidence: | .Letrec defs b => FV_defs defs ∪ (FV b \ (fun x => x ∈ defs.map (fun (f, _, _) => cml_id.Short f)))
errors.why_wrong: In HOL4, `∪` and `DIFF` are left-associative operators with equal precedence, so `FV_defs defs ∪ FV b DIFF set ...` parses as `(FV_defs defs ∪ FV b) DIFF set ...`. By placing parentheses around `FV b \ ...`, Lean fails to remove the bound recursive function names from `FV_defs defs`, incorrectly leaving them as free variables of the letrec expression.

notes: In a recursive letrec, recursive function names bound by the definitions should be bound within the bodies of the mutual definitions in `defs` as well as in `b`.
